message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Title | Year Published | Notes |
|-------|----------------|-------|
| **Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone** (titled *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | First book in the Harry Potter series; introduces Hogwarts and the wizarding world. |
| **Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets** | 1998 | Second installment; follows Harry’s return to school and the mystery of the Chamber. |
| **Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban** | 1999 | Third book; introduces Sirius Black and the Marauder’s Map. |
| **Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire** | 2000 | Fourth book; features the Triwizard Tournament. |
| **Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix** | 2003 | Fifth book; focuses on the formation of Dumbledore’s Army. |
| **Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince** | 2005 | Sixth book; delves into Voldemort’s past and Horcruxes. |
| **Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows** | 2007 | Final book; concludes the epic saga. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Rowling’s first adult novel; a dark political drama set in a small English town. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | Debut crime novel under her pseudonym; part of the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Cormoran Strike Series** (books 1–5) | 2013–2023 | A series of detective novels featuring private investigator Cormoran Strike and his assistant Robin Ellacott. |

These titles have sold millions worldwide and have been adapted into blockbuster films, stage plays, and other media.
